overview: Udaipur's lakes and palaces plus Jodhpur's mighty Mehrangarh Fort, timed for Deepavali when the old cities glow with lamps and lights.
fit: Good for both kids; festival crowds and fireworks need care with the 4-year-old.
season: October–November is the festive season and pleasant (15–30°C). December–January is cool. Summers are extremely hot.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Udaipur (1-stop); Jodhpur to Chennai (1-stop)
gettingThere.cost: ₹40,000–60,000 for 4 (festive fares are high; book by July)

gettingThere.detail: Udaipur to Jodhpur via Ranakpur Jain temple

gettingAround: Cab between the cities, stopping at Ranakpur and Kumbhalgarh if time allows.

todo.title: Mehrangarh Fort, Jodhpur
todo.why: Fort museum with cradles, turbans and palanquins

todo.title: Clock tower market, Jodhpur
todo.why: Spices and bangles; try the lassi

stay.why: Watch the lights from the rooftop

foodTips: Ask for less chilli. Many places close on Deepavali day itself, so plan meals.
save: Book festival flights and hotels by July
Travel a few days after Deepavali for lower prices
Use one cab for the intercity drive with sightseeing stops
safety: Firecrackers everywhere on Deepavali night; keep the kids indoors or on a rooftop
Very crowded lanes; agree a meeting point
health: Smoke from crackers can bother kids with asthma
kids: Let the 10-year-old light diyas at the hotel
Plan quiet afternoons; festival evenings are long

days.plan: Fly to Udaipur; lake boat at sunset
City Palace; Bagore ki Haveli show; Deepavali lights
Drive to Jodhpur via Ranakpur and Kumbhalgarh
